label: Area 8
warning: PRELIMINARY ANALYSIS — EXPERIMENTAL — registration, datum, surface classification and reporting boundaries require review. Not a validated scientific conclusion.
evidence: Historical LAS headers declare EPSG:27700; the QGIS project assigns EPSG:7405 (ODN) to earlier clouds, but datum and registration are not independently verified. Old records called padstow_estuary_boundary refer to Padstow-named clipped clouds and the Padstow polygon in the QGIS project; they are not evidence of an estuary-wide footprint. Candidate polygons match current QGIS-referenced files, but clip-time versions were not hash-pinned. Tide and surface classification are unverified.
